Subject: SIG: production peering — initial inventory and ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security team is working through the SIG and we need a couple of concrete items for the network/security section so the SIG owner can close this out. Can you please provide: 

- A current topology diagram showing VPC peering or PrivateLink endpoints for production (preferably PDF).
- The canonical egress IP ranges we should allowlist for outbound connections to Acme services.
- Any constraints on CIDR sizes or overlapping ranges for peering.
- Confirmation whether Redwood supports Private Endpoints (API) in our region or requires a peering-based approach.

We'd like to circulate the evidence to our compliance reviewers by EOD Friday (8/6). If you prefer, send the topology and a short note and we'll attach to the SIG sheet.

Thanks,
Jill Harper
Security Manager, Acme Analytics
jill.harper@acme-analytics.com

Date: 2026-08-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: production peering — initial inventory and ask

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear list. We're attaching an initial topology and a filled peering template. Answers inline below and in attachments: 

- Topology: attached "redwood_vpc_topology_v1.drawio.pdf" (diagram shows hosted control plane + dedicated peering and Private Endpoint option).
- Egress IPs: attached CSV "egress_ip_list.csv" with the current stable IP set for the us-west region. These are the IPs you can allowlist for outbound callbacks.
- CIDR overlap: we require non-overlapping /16 or smaller on the customer side for peering; we can accept a /20 if you request it for dev but production should use at least a /24 (we note this in the peering template).
- Private Endpoints: we support private endpoint-style connections in the Dedicated model via PrivateLink (see topology). For Hosted customers we usually recommend VPC peering into a Routed VPC; the PDF annotates both options and the pros/cons.

Rohan is looping in the exact peering acceptance form and the network rules that our infra team enforces. Let us know if you want a short call to walk through the diagram — otherwise we'll push the finalized evidence and links by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG: production peering — initial inventory and ask

Forwarding Jill's request and our draft attachments. Quick notes for the thread: 

- The egress IP list is stable for the next quarter but we rotate a small subset during maintenance windows; we mark rotation windows in the CSV (column "rotation_window"). Recommend telling Acme to include a 7-day maintenance allowance.
- Peering acceptance requires a ticket to infra with the filled template + the Acme peering CIDR. We can accept /20 through /24; for production we prefer /20+/24 (non-overlapping).
- PrivateLink: works in us-west-2 and us-east-1; for other regions we fall back to peering. Note this in our response.

I'll attach the internal peering checklist for operations (not for customer) as a separate internal artifact — do not share externally.

-Rohan
